description: This file contains abstract classes and concrete implementations for evaluating Hive User Defined Functions (UDFs) within Spark SQL, including handling of generic UDFs and simple UDFs, with mechanisms for reflection, object inspection, and error handling.

classes.name: HiveUDFEvaluatorBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for evaluating Hive UDFs with common functionality such as function creation, determinism check, and evaluation with error handling.

classes.name: HiveSimpleUDFEvaluator
classes.description: Concrete class for evaluating simple Hive UDFs using reflection to invoke the UDF method, with argument conversion and unwrapper logic.

classes.name: HiveGenericUDFEvaluator
classes.description: Concrete class for evaluating generic Hive UDFs, handling initialization, constant folding, and deferred object management.

classes.name: DeferredObjectAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class converting Catalyst expressions to Hive DeferredObject, with support for setting evaluation functions.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Executes the UDF evaluation, catching exceptions and wrapping errors with detailed context.

methods.name: setArg
methods.description: Sets the argument value at a specific index for the UDF evaluation.

methods.name: doEvaluate
methods.description: Performs the actual UDF evaluation logic, implemented in subclasses.
